criteria.dual_mode: Recover break positions from a parallel html pass and merge them into the callback-built tree.
criteria.normalize_soft:
Collapse both break kinds to ordinary newlines and accept the lost
fidelity.
criteria.reject_hard: Detect hard-break markers in the source up front and fail the document loudly with markdown::rejected_break.

break_policy.instructions: Since callbacks erase the soft/hard break distinction, what break semantics must safe output implement?

criteria.allow_all_native: Mirror Bun output exactly (http, mailto:, fragments) and widen html.ts accordingly, enabling autolinks.
criteria.allow_fragments: Add same-document #fragment links and heading self anchors to the strict set, teaching parseURL to admit fragments.
criteria.strict_https_local: https plus site-local paths; no autolinks, no self anchors; anything else fails as markdown::unsupported_url.

link_scope.instructions: How wide should the accepted href set be: gate-native links only, or extensions toward fragments and native autolink schemes?

criteria.drop_details: Keep the skeleton, shed the specifics: emit lists and tables while quietly ignoring alignment and start offsets.
criteria.full_fidelity: Grow the gate to match the parser: admit align (left/center/right) on header and data cells plus start on ordered lists, and emit every observed value including task checkboxes.
criteria.subset_reject: Fail fast with markdown::unsupported_construct on any document using aligned columns, offset numbering, or task bullets instead of degrading them.

table_list_fidelity.instructions: How must the renderer treat list and table particulars (alignment, numbering origin, task state) that the sanitizer attribute table lacks?

state: For B1-12 the Can toolchain targets pinned Bun 1.4.2 and must turn Markdown into HTML that the runtime sanitizer accepts: only trees passing runtime/platform/html.ts checks may reach renderSafe. Pinned probes of Bun.markdown.render show a faithful structural feed once camelCase names are used: listItem events carry index, depth, ordering, the ordered start, and the checked flag for task bullets, while the table family (table/thead/tbody/tr/th/td) reports column align where declared. The same probes cage the unsafe corners: enabling wikiLinks makes render drop every wiki target without a trace (html output uses ), so the flag stays off; raw markup is neutralized by noHtmlBlocks plus noHtmlSpans, which demote tags to ordinary text, whereas html mode would splice them in untouched and tagFilter would merely convert
